notes: «وقتيبة، وابن، حجر جميعا» are co-transmitters at one level, converging at «إسماعيل بن جعفر» (rule 2)
«- قال ابن أيوب حدثنا إسماعيل، -» names the same man again: a pure wording variant, left out (rule 4)
«أبيه» is named only by relation; the dash glosses are not closed in the stored text and are read as the main chain

fixes.reason: K6I lists إسماعيل بن أبي خالد الأحمسي as a separate narrator; the text names only إسماعيل بن جعفر in the chain, and the bare إسماعيل in the variant names no one.
